title: Patient Care Desk Guidance - Dose Entries Dated After an Immunization Services Course Closed
content:
**Immunization Services: the rule the desk applies to dose entries dated after a course closed, when the course's valid doses still needed are rebuilt because a dose on it is found not to count.**

> Dose entries dated after a course closed are handled as follows, counting as such the entries dated within the whole calendar months since the closing date. Where every such entry carries a lot number and Kestrel gave a dose of the course at one of its stores, 0 of them are set aside, since a closed series is resumed and not restarted. Where every such entry carries a lot number and Kestrel gave no dose of the course, all but one of them are set aside. In every other case, including where any such entry carries no lot number, every entry dated after the closing date is set aside.

### Which entries count as dated after the closing

- A course has a closing date when it was completed or cancelled; a course with no closing date has no entries dated after its closing.
- **Whole calendar months** from an earlier date to a later date are the difference in calendar months between the two, less one where the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's.
- A dose-given entry dated no later than today counts as dated after the closing when the whole calendar months from its date to today are fewer than the whole calendar months from the closing date to today.

*Hypothetical dates.* A course closed on 10 March and today is 5 September of the same year: 6 months apart, less one because 5 is smaller than 10, so 5 whole calendar months. An entry dated 12 April is 4 whole calendar months before today (5, less one because 5 is smaller than 12), fewer than 5, so it counts. An entry dated 2 April is 5 whole calendar months before today, not fewer than 5, so it does not count. An entry dated 1 March is 6 whole calendar months before today and does not count.

### What is set aside

| Entries counted as dated after the closing | Kestrel gave a dose of the course at one of its stores | Set aside |
|---|---|---|
| All carry a lot number | yes (at least 1 dose entry names a Kestrel store) | 0 |
| All carry a lot number | no (no dose entry names a Kestrel store) | all but one |
| At least one carries no lot number | either | every one of them |
| None | either | none |

### Questions answered

**Why does nothing go aside when the entries are documented and Kestrel gave a dose?** Because a closed series is resumed and not restarted; documented entries after the closing then stand.

**How many go aside when three documented entries follow the closing and no Kestrel store gave any dose of the course?** All but one: 3 less 1, so 2 (hypothetical figures).

**What if one of those three entries has no lot number?** Every one of the three is set aside, whether or not Kestrel gave a dose of the course (hypothetical figures).
